Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 91: Holiday 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #91 shipped to subscribers in December 2008 (bearing the cover date of Holiday 2008 or January 2009 for Issue 91). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #91 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable media, and exclusive previews:

Prince of Persia (action-adventure platformer)
Skate 2 (skateboarding simulation)
The Lord of the Rings: Conquest (action hack-and-slash)
Destroy All Humans! Path of the Furon (action-adventure)
Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix (Xbox Live Arcade fighting game)
A Kingdom for Keflings (Xbox Live Arcade city-building management)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics and themes, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Halo Wars, Resident Evil 5, and Street Fighter IV, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
